defaults._doc_android_packages: Android application ids of the terminal apps this flake is meant to configure. EVERY on-device path this flake writes and every intent it sends is namespaced by one of these -- /data/data/<id>/files/{home,usr} -- so this list is the single source the rest derives from, and flake.nix emits one nixOnDroidConfiguration per entry. It is a LIST, not a scalar, because the two apps coexist: com.termux.nix is the official Nix-on-Droid app, cld.termux.nix is our fork (renamed 2026-08-30 in cloud-u-android/ac_cloud-nix-on-droid so it installs alongside instead of colliding). Before 2026-09-09 the id was written out by hand 31 times across seven files under src/ and pinned in two readOnly options (user.home, build.installationDir) by the nix-on-droid input, so the flake could only ever activate inside com.termux.nix -- Home Manager aborts activation when $HOME is not the eval-time home.homeDirectory -- and the renamed app received NO configuration at all, including the ~/.termux/termux.properties that RunCommandService requires before it will accept the boot companion's intent.
defaults._doc_android_package: Which entry of android_packages `nixOnDroidConfigurations.default` (and therefore CI, which builds `default`) targets. Kept on com.termux.nix so the instance that works today keeps working; the renamed app is reached by name, `--flake path:src#cld.termux.nix`.
